Triggers on phrases like 'log these to Linear', 'create Linear issues for each finding', 'import this code review into Linear', or any prompt that points at a markdown file with `[CRITICAL]`/`[HIGH]`/`[MEDIUM]`/`[LOW]` severity-tagged sections.

The plan and worker fan out parallel subagents via the Workflow tool (in small batches to avoid throttling) to speed up large investigations.
